🆕 Beta Changelog

---

⚠️ This is a Beta Release. Features and fixes in this version are still under testing and may contain bugs or unexpected behavior. Please report any issues you encounter. Do not use in production.

---

🌟 Features
• full cast support by @RyanYuuki
• option to hide/show continue watching by @RyanYuuki
• enhanced orientation control by @RyanYuuki

🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements
• repeated search calls on errror fixed by @RyanYuuki
• fixed tracking issues and new episode release stale states by @RyanYuuki
• fixed speed and audio pane not showing for downloaded media by @RyanYuuki
• overflow fix on anime and manga list by @RyanYuuki
• fixed repos showing as added yet empty list by @RyanYuuki
• wait until login info is loaded for deeplink by @RyanYuuki
• fixed animation delay for tabs on calendar page by @RyanYuuki
• safe guarding media type by @RyanYuuki

🎨 Style Changes
• little improvement to info below title on media details page by @RyanYuuki

🧹 Chores & Documentation
• dropped bridge mode by @RyanYuuki
